# KernelN64 named GameShark codes
# Mario-head stretch preset v1
# SM64 expanded preset catalog v2
# SM64 music presets v4
# SM64 music-only bursts v5
[CHEAT]
NAME=Audio\Music experiments\delayed notes and catch-up bursts (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible US extensions. Repeats about 4.27 seconds of stalled music progression and 4.27 seconds at 288 BPM at the normal 30 game frames/s. Applies immediately using the running game clock, so activation may begin in either phase. A song can change during a phase. Changes only music-player 0/1 tempo: no pitch, note-gate, sample, code or pointer writes. Sound-effect player tempo stays unchanged. Already playing notes or sample/reverb tails may continue during a stall; it is not a hard mute or a queued-audio replay. An approximation of the supplied delayed-then-fast music reference, not an exact reconstruction or MIDI import. Disable to restore owned tempo bytes without a ROM restart; music position is not rewound. Conflicts with other tempo locks, but separate pitch effects can be used. KernelN64 chained D1/D2 condition semantics required; other engines and physical GameSharks are untested. Source: n64decomp/sm64 9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af src/game/game_init.c display_and_vsync, src/audio/seqplayer.c and internal.h. Verified timer at 8032D5D4, incremented by code at 802481B4..802481C4. Timer is read only.
GROUP=sound
ADDRESSING=
ENABLED=false

[CHEAT]
NAME=Audio\Music experiments\delayed notes and catch-up bursts - faster bursts (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible extensions. Keeps the original approximately 4.27-second delay and 4.27-second burst phases. During bursts only, music-player 0/1 layer, channel and player delays are divided by 2 per sequencer update instead of subtracting one. This makes bursts faster through compressed countdowns, not a higher BPM or uniform speed multiplier. Music tick tempo remains 288 BPM. Guest instructions remain original throughout. No pitch, sample or pointer changes. Sound-effect player 2 always executes the original countdowns. Use one delay/burst preset at a time. Conflicts with other tempo/countdown patches; code needs the KernelN64 B0 music-countdown extension and chained conditions. Other engines and hardware GameSharks are unsupported. An approximation, not an exact corruption match. Already queued audio can finish; the music position is not rewound. Source: n64decomp/sm64 9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af src/audio/seqplayer.c and src/game/game_init.c. Verified US countdown decrements at 8031C100, 8031D130 and 8031DC54. The B0 extension scopes execution to verified music ownership; it does not patch those instructions.
GROUP=sound
ADDRESSING=
ENABLED=false

B0222618 0001

[CHEAT]
NAME=Audio\Music experiments\delayed notes and catch-up bursts - extremely fast bursts (approximation)
NOTE=SM64 US v1.0 / verified compatible extensions. Keeps the original approximately 4.27-second delay and 4.27-second burst phases. During bursts only, music-player 0/1 layer, channel and player delays are divided by 4 per sequencer update instead of subtracting one. This makes bursts faster through compressed countdowns, not a higher BPM or uniform speed multiplier. Music tick tempo remains 288 BPM. Guest instructions remain original throughout. No pitch, sample or pointer changes. Sound-effect player 2 always executes the original countdowns. Use one delay/burst preset at a time. Conflicts with other tempo/countdown patches; code needs the KernelN64 B0 music-countdown extension and chained conditions. Other engines and hardware GameSharks are unsupported. An approximation, not an exact corruption match. Already queued audio can finish; the music position is not rewound. Source: n64decomp/sm64 9921382a68bb0c865e5e45eb594d9c64db59b1af src/audio/seqplayer.c and src/game/game_init.c. Verified US countdown decrements at 8031C100, 8031D130 and 8031DC54. The B0 extension scopes execution to verified music ownership; it does not patch those instructions.
GROUP=sound
ADDRESSING=
ENABLED=false
